definitions.observation_time: bar_open_ms + four hours, including accepted final equity mark
definitions.peak: initial capital at window start; then latest close at or above prior peak; equality recovers
definitions.duration: last equal peak to first recovery close, or observed end for a right-censored episode
definitions.underwater_share: fraction of close observations strictly below running peak; not intrabar wall time
definitions.below_initial_share: fraction of close observations strictly below 10000 USDT
definitions.right_censoring: no observed recovery by sample end; future recovery time is unknown
